nexaboard-desc:
{{desc|name=NexaBoard|url=https://nexawiki.com/}}
Short description of the extension shown on [[Special:Version]].
nexaboard-welcome-title:
Heading of the welcome card shown at the top of a user's board. Parameters:
* $1 - the wiki's site name ({{msg-mw|Sitename}}).
nexaboard-welcome-body:
Body text of the welcome card shown at the top of a user's board. Parsed as wikitext. Parameters:
* $1 - the prefixed title of the local guidelines page (e.g. "Project:Board guidelines"), linked from the message.
nexaboard: The name of [[Special:NexaBoard]], shown as the page title and in [[Special:SpecialPages]].
nexaboard-title:
Page title shown on a specific user's board. Parameters:
* $1 - the username whose board is being viewed.
nexaboard-guidelines-pagename: Page name (without namespace prefix) of the guidelines page automatically created in the project namespace when the extension is installed.
nexaboard-guidelines-summary: Edit summary used when the extension automatically creates the guidelines page on install.
nexaboard-guidelines-content:
Wikitext content of the guidelines page automatically created on install. Parameters:
* $1 - the wiki's site name ({{msg-mw|Sitename}}).
Contains section headings and wiki links; keep the markup intact when translating.
nexaboard-no-user: Error shown when [[Special:NexaBoard]] is opened without specifying a user.
nexaboard-user-not-found:
Error shown when the requested board belongs to a user who does not exist. Parameters:
* $1 - the username that was requested.
nexaboard-empty: Placeholder shown on a board that has no messages yet.
nexaboard-leave-message: Label prompting the viewer to leave a message on the board.
nexaboard-new-message-title: Heading of the form for composing a new message thread.
nexaboard-title-placeholder: Placeholder text for the subject/headline field of a new message.
nexaboard-body-placeholder: Placeholder text for the body field of a new message.
nexaboard-reply-placeholder: Placeholder text for the reply input field.
nexaboard-post-btn:
{{Identical|Post}}
Label of the button that submits a new message.
nexaboard-reply-btn:
{{Identical|Reply}}
Label of the button that submits or opens a reply.
nexaboard-cancel-btn:
{{Identical|Cancel}}
Label of the button that cancels composing a message or reply.
nexaboard-close-btn: Label of the button that closes a thread to further replies.
nexaboard-delete-btn:
{{Identical|Delete}}
Label of the button that deletes a thread.
nexaboard-reopen-btn: Label of the button that reopens a previously closed thread.
nexaboard-closed-label: Badge shown on a thread that has been closed. Displayed in uppercase.
nexaboard-move-msg-btn:
{{Identical|Move}}
Label of the button that moves a message to another thread.
nexaboard-merge-btn: Label of the button that opens the merge-threads interface.
nexaboard-post-success: Confirmation shown after a message is successfully posted.
nexaboard-delete-confirm: JavaScript confirmation prompt shown before deleting a thread.
nexaboard-close-confirm: JavaScript confirmation prompt shown before closing a thread.
nexaboard-merge-confirm: JavaScript confirmation prompt shown before merging threads.
nexaboard-move-confirm: JavaScript confirmation prompt shown before moving a message.
nexaboard-error-generic: Generic error shown when an action fails for an unknown reason.
nexaboard-error-notitle: Error shown when a message is submitted without a subject line.
nexaboard-error-nobody: Error shown when a message is submitted with an empty body.
nexaboard-error-toolong:
Error shown when a subject exceeds the maximum length. Parameters:
* $1 - the maximum number of characters allowed.
nexaboard-error-merge-self: Error shown when a user tries to merge a thread into itself.
nexaboard-error-move-thread: Error shown when no target thread ID is entered for a move.
nexaboard-show-replies:
Label of the control that expands a thread's replies. Parameters:
* $1 - the number of replies.
nexaboard-hide-replies: Label of the control that collapses a thread's replies.
nexaboard-collapse-replies: Tooltip on the vertical thread line, which collapses the branch of replies hanging off it.
nexaboard-expand-replies:
Label of the chip that reopens a collapsed branch. Parameters:
* $1 - the number of replies hidden in the branch
nexaboard-threads:
Displays the number of threads on a board. Parameters:
* $1 - the number of threads.
nexaboard-sort-newest:
{{Identical|Newest}}
Label of the option to sort threads newest first.
nexaboard-sort-oldest:
{{Identical|Oldest}}
Label of the option to sort threads oldest first.
nexaboard-login-required: Notice shown to logged-out users explaining that they must log in to post. Contains a wiki link to [[Special:UserLogin]].
nexaboard-board-owner: Note shown to a user when they are viewing their own board.
nexaboard-nopermission: Notice shown when the viewer is logged in but lacks permission to post on boards.
nexaboard-thread-deleted: Placeholder shown in place of a thread that has been deleted.
nexaboard-prev-page:
{{Identical|Previous}}
Label of the pagination link to the previous page of threads.
nexaboard-next-page:
{{Identical|Next}}
Label of the pagination link to the next page of threads.
nexaboard-tab-nexaboard: Label of the Board tab shown next to the user page and discussion tabs.
nexaboard-merge-desc: Instructions shown in the merge-threads panel.
nexaboard-merge-target: Label for the field selecting the destination thread of a merge.
nexaboard-merge-reason-placeholder: Placeholder for the optional reason field when merging threads.
nexaboard-merge-start: Label of the button that turns on merge mode. Distinct from nexaboard-merge-btn, which performs the merge.
nexaboard-merge-select-label: Visible label on each thread's checkbox while merge mode is active.
nexaboard-merge-count:
Live count of threads selected as merge sources. Parameters:
* $1 - the number of selected source threads
nexaboard-bulk-select-label: Visible label on each thread's checkbox while bulk-selection mode is active.
nexaboard-move-target-placeholder: Placeholder for the target thread ID field when moving a message.
nexaboard-move-reason-placeholder: Placeholder for the optional reason field when moving a message.
nexaboard-thread-id:
Visible thread identifier shown next to a thread's timestamp, and the label of its permalink. Parameters:
* $1 - the thread ID
nexaboard-message-id:
Visible message identifier shown next to a reply's timestamp, and the label of its permalink. Parameters:
* $1 - the message ID
nexaboard-permalink-thread-title:
Tooltip on a thread's permalink. Parameters:
* $1 - the thread ID
nexaboard-permalink-message-title:
Tooltip on a message's permalink. Parameters:
* $1 - the message ID
nexaboard-thread-option:
Label for a thread in the merge and move destination dropdowns. Includes the ID so that two threads sharing a title can be told apart. Parameters:
* $1 - the thread ID
* $2 - the thread title
nexaboard-move-target: Label of the destination dropdown in the move panel.
nexaboard-move-target-other: Label of the free-text thread ID field in the move panel, used to move a message into a thread that is not on the current page.
nexaboard-move-subject:
Line in the move panel naming what is being moved. Parameters:
* $1 - the message ID
* $2 - the ID of the thread it is currently in
nexaboard-error-move-same: Error shown when the chosen destination is the thread the message is already in.
nexaboard-log-name: Name of the log of board administrative actions, shown at [[Special:Log]].
nexaboard-log-header: Description shown at the top of the board administrative log.
notification-header-nexaboard-post:
Echo notification header when someone posts on your board. Parameters:
* $1 - the name of the user who posted.
notification-body-nexaboard-post:
Echo notification body showing the subject of a new post. Parameters:
* $3 - the subject/headline of the message.
notification-link-nexaboard-view-board: Label of the Echo notification link that opens the board.
notification-link-nexaboard-view-thread: Label of the Echo notification link that opens the thread.
echo-pref-tooltip-nexaboard: Tooltip for the NexaBoard category in the Echo notification preferences.
nexaboard-edit-btn: Label of the button that opens the inline editor for a message.
nexaboard-reply-to-btn: Label of the button that replies to one specific reply rather than to the thread.
nexaboard-follow-btn: Label of the button that subscribes the viewer to a thread's notifications.
nexaboard-unfollow-btn: Label of the button that unsubscribes the viewer from a thread's notifications.
nexaboard-undelete-btn: Label of the button that restores a deleted thread or message.
nexaboard-delete-replies-btn: Label of the button that deletes every reply in a thread, keeping the thread.
nexaboard-save-btn: Label of the button that saves an edited message.
nexaboard-deleted-label: Badge shown on a deleted message. Keep it short.
nexaboard-edited-marker:
Note shown under a message that has been edited. Parameters:
* $1 - the formatted date and time of the last edit
nexaboard-replying-to:
Note in the reply form naming the message being replied to. Parameters:
* $1 - the message ID
nexaboard-merged-from:
Note on a thread listing the titles of threads merged into it. Parameters:
* $1 - the number of merged threads
* $2 - a comma-separated list of their quoted titles
nexaboard-edit-title-label: Label of the subject field shown when editing the first message of a thread.
nexaboard-show-deleted: Label of the toggle that reveals deleted and merged threads to moderators.
nexaboard-hide-deleted: Label of the toggle that hides deleted and merged threads again.
nexaboard-bulk-select: Label of the button that turns on multi-thread selection.
nexaboard-bulk-selectall: Label of the control that selects every thread on the page.
nexaboard-bulk-selectnone: Label of the control that clears the thread selection.
nexaboard-bulk-count:
Count of currently selected threads. Parameters:
* $1 - the number of selected threads
nexaboard-bulk-delete-threads: Label of the button that deletes all selected threads.
nexaboard-bulk-delete-replies: Label of the button that deletes all replies in the selected threads.
nexaboard-bulk-confirm-threads:
Confirmation before bulk-deleting threads. Parameters:
* $1 - the number of selected threads
nexaboard-bulk-confirm-replies:
Confirmation before bulk-deleting replies. Parameters:
* $1 - the number of selected threads
nexaboard-reopen-confirm: Confirmation before reopening a closed thread.
nexaboard-undelete-confirm: Confirmation before restoring a deleted thread.
nexaboard-delete-msg-confirm: Confirmation before deleting a single message.
nexaboard-undelete-msg-confirm: Confirmation before restoring a single deleted message.
nexaboard-delete-replies-confirm: Confirmation before deleting every reply in one thread.
nexaboard-personal-board: Label of the "Board" entry in the personal tools menu.
nexaboard-personal-talk: Label of the entry in the personal tools menu that links to the user's own talk page.
nexaboard-link-board: Replacement text for a "Talk" link that has been rewritten to point at a board. Lowercase to match the surrounding link text.
nexaboard-error-crossboard: Error shown when a merge or move would take messages across two different users' boards.
nexaboard-error-delete-op: Error shown when someone tries to delete the first message of a thread.
nexaboard-error-edit-deleted: Error shown when someone tries to edit a message that has been deleted.
nexaboard-error-edit-closed: Error shown when an author tries to edit their message in a thread that has since been closed.
logentry-nexaboard-close: {{Logentry|and $4 is the thread ID, $5 the thread title}}
logentry-nexaboard-reopen: {{Logentry|and $4 is the thread ID, $5 the thread title}}
logentry-nexaboard-delete: {{Logentry|and $4 is the thread ID, $5 the thread title}}
logentry-nexaboard-undelete: {{Logentry|and $4 is the thread ID, $5 the thread title}}
logentry-nexaboard-deletemsg: {{Logentry|and $4 is the message ID, $5 the thread ID}}
logentry-nexaboard-undeletemsg: {{Logentry|and $4 is the message ID, $5 the thread ID}}
logentry-nexaboard-deletereplies: {{Logentry|and $4 is the thread ID, $5 the number of replies deleted}}
logentry-nexaboard-edit: {{Logentry|and $4 is the message ID, $5 the thread ID}}
logentry-nexaboard-merge: {{Logentry|and $4 is the destination thread ID, $5 a list of source thread IDs, $6 the number of source threads}}
logentry-nexaboard-move: {{Logentry|and $4 is the message ID, $5 the source thread ID, $6 the destination thread ID}}
nexaboard-transfer-btn: Label of the button that opens the transfer panel, moving a whole thread to another user's board.
nexaboard-transfer-subject:
Line in the transfer panel naming the thread being moved. Parameters:
* $1 - the thread ID
* $2 - the thread title
nexaboard-transfer-target: Label for the destination username field in the transfer panel.
nexaboard-transfer-target-placeholder:
{{Identical|Username}}
Placeholder for the destination username field.
nexaboard-transfer-submit: Label of the button that performs the transfer.
nexaboard-transfer-confirm: JavaScript confirmation prompt shown before transferring a thread to another board.
nexaboard-error-transfer-notarget: Error shown when the transfer is submitted with no destination username.
nexaboard-error-transfer-nouser: Error shown when the destination username does not match a registered user.
nexaboard-error-transfer-same: Error shown when the destination board is the one the thread is already on.
nexaboard-error-transfer-failed: Error shown when a transfer fails for any other reason.
logentry-nexaboard-transfer:
Log entry for transferring a thread between boards. Parameters:
* $1 - the performer, linked
* $2 - the performer's username, for GENDER
* $3 - the destination user page, linked
* $4 - the thread ID
* $5 - the thread title
* $6 - the username of the board the thread came from
nexaboard-merged-label: Badge shown on a thread that was merged into another. Displayed in uppercase, alongside {{msg-mw|nexaboard-closed-label}}.
nexaboard-merged-into: Link shown on a merged source thread, pointing at the thread its messages were moved into. Parameters:\n* $1 - the destination thread ID
nexaboard-error-reopen-notyours: Error shown when a board owner tries to reopen a thread that somebody else — normally a moderator — closed.
nexaboard-edited-marker-by:
Marker shown under a message that was last edited by somebody other than its author. Parameters:
* $1 - when the edit was made
* $2 - the username of the editor
Compare {{msg-mw|nexaboard-edited-marker}}, used when the author edited their own message.
nexaboard-error-move-op: Error shown when someone tries to move a thread's originating post into another thread. Moving it would leave the source thread with nothing to display.
nexaboard-hidden-shown: Note shown to moderators when the deleted-and-merged toggle is on and there are some on the current page. Parameters:\n* $1 - how many deleted or merged threads are on this page
nexaboard-hidden-none: Note shown to moderators when the deleted-and-merged toggle is on but the current page contains none, so that the toggle does not look broken.
nexaboard-error-toolong-storage: Error shown when a title or body fits the configured character limit but still exceeds what the database column can hold, which would otherwise truncate it mid-character. Only reachable if the limits are configured above the column capacity.
nexaboard-error-merge-target-state: Error shown when the merge destination is a deleted or already-merged thread. Merging into a deleted thread would hide live messages with no deletion recorded.
nexaboard-error-merge-source-state: Error shown when a merge source is deleted or already merged. Merging a deleted thread would move its still-live messages into a readable thread and undo the deletion.
nexaboard-error-too-deep: Error shown when a reply would nest deeper than BoardManager::MAX_REPLY_DEPTH allows.
nexaboard-blocked: Notice shown in place of the posting form when the viewer is blocked from acting on this board. Covers sitewide blocks and partial blocks that cover the board owner's User talk: page.
nexaboard-tab-about: {{Identical|About}}\nLabel of the first tab in the user tab bar, linking to the user page.
nexaboard-tab-contributions: {{Identical|Contributions}}\nLabel of the third tab in the user tab bar, linking to [[Special:Contributions]] for that user.
